blockers.title: The claimed null/object carrier bijection still licenses an omitted doctor-side projection that has no decoder or round-trip row
evidence: destinations.policyProvenance expressly permits the consentRecords[].scope.policyProvenance projection to be absent/null when consentCarrier is invocation-time-naming.

The new destinations.consentCarrier decoder defines only two cases: a null policyProvenance reconstructs invocation-time-naming and a well-formed object reconstructs pre-existing-policy. consentCarrierPredicateDomain.rule likewise says policyProvenance is null exactly in the invocation branch and calls those two shapes total. No clause equates a missing JSON member with null.

The contract therefore gives incompatible instructions for the omitted state. If the closed 15-member scope requires presence, destinations.policyProvenance wrongly licenses absence. If the member is optional outside requiredWhen=pre-existing-policy, absence is a legal third representation that the claimed two-shape bijection cannot decode.
All seven FC-CARRIER-SHAPE rows include a policyProvenance key. The two added round-trip rows cover present-null and present-object only; no omitted-member row declares reconstruction or refusal.

doctorV4FieldMapping.rule is total over every legal source value and says an unmapped member is a contract defect. A producer taking the expressly allowed absent branch drops the only doctor-side carrier encoding, reopening that load-bearing defect for invocation-time-naming.
blockers.impact: Two implementations can both follow normative text yet diverge: one emits explicit null and round-trips, while another omits the projection and leaves the carrier unreconstructable unless it invents an unstated missing-equals-null rule. That defeats deterministic authorization evidence and the promised 19-member mapping totality.
blockers.requiredRepair: Choose one canonical invocation-time representation everywhere. Prefer requiring consentRecords[].scope.policyProvenance to be present and null, remove absent from destinations.policyProvenance, and add an omitted-member refusal row. Alternatively define omission explicitly as the encoding and revise the exact-null, two-shape bijection, mapping, and fixture language consistently. Every legal emitted representation must have a declared inverse.
